configuration_change_test.observed_boundary: Legacy raw read-only sandbox acquired named :read-only profile after reload. Dispatch stopped on activePermissionProfile mismatch, with computation exit_code 0 preserved.

limitations: Linux only; original shared app-server must remain alive and host must reach the model provider.
Old/--no-daemon sessions without a verified shared control endpoint cannot guarantee continuation.
tmux does not survive host reboot.
User approvals and client-owned tools can require frontend reconnection.
Effective settings changes or writer conflicts stop dispatch; no automatic permission overrides or external fallback.
evidence_handling: Public summary omits local usernames, absolute paths, thread/turn identifiers and full RPC payloads. Original records remain available locally outside the published branch.

lifecycle_coverage: Default worker window closes after monitoring, retaining logs and results.
Pending approvals keep the worker alive until monitoring finishes.
Failed computation and failed continuation also close the worker window.
Explicit --keep-tmux retains the exited pane for debugging.
Global remain-on-exit stays unchanged; unrelated sessions remain alive.
Expired and interrupted monitoring can recover without rerunning or redispatching; legacy manifests default to auto-close.
tmux_cleanup_validation.release_status: Source update and local package only; existing v2.1.0 release unchanged.

environment.transport: isolated fake RPC; no model calls

coverage: Consumed results are not delivered after idle or recover.
Notification cancellation preserves running computation, logs, results and unrelated tmux sessions.
Cancellation before send prevents dispatch; cancellation after send preserves turn identity.
Lost send reply remains unknown and is never resent after retirement.
Same-workflow replacements suppress old notifications, including during running computation and send races.
Independent workflows retain independent notification delivery.
Live legacy workers without control capability reject false cancellation; stopped legacy jobs can be retired.
Failed computation can be acknowledged without claiming success.
Transient errors, wait-expiry flags and pending request summaries do not leak into later observations.
Existing identity/settings, exact-turn, reply-loss, recovery and tmux-lifecycle regressions remain covered.
